name: tests-75pct-stripe-cli-drainable-streaming-sessions
instr:
Add a shared drain coordinator and public drain methods for websocket, proxy, log-tailer, and RPC components. Preserve existing behavior.

Coordinator admission succeeds before draining. Drain closes admission irreversibly; later Admit returns nil and ErrDraining without changing counts. Wait for independently admitted tokens to complete, including reverse completion order. Each successful completion contributes to Completed; successful final reports have Accepted=Completed and Failed=0 with OutcomeCompleted. Empty drains have zero counts. Concurrent and later drains retain the final outcome/counts independently of mutations to returned reports.

Canceling a pending drain waiter returns OutcomeCanceled without reopening admission or canceling other waiters. Later drains observe completed work.

After Run with an already canceled context, websocket Drain accounts Accepted=Completed+Failed. Canceled log-tailer Run terminates; its Drain returns cancellation or fully accounted work. Empty NewTailer reports OutcomeCompleted and zero counts; New remains compatible. Canceled proxy Init returns an error or a nonnil drainable proxy; canceled Drain reports cancellation or fully accounted work. Deprecated thin configuration remains constructible. Returned Accepted counts are independent across repeated websocket/proxy drains and empty RPC shutdowns.

RPC shutdown without streams has a repeatable zero-count OutcomeCompleted report, including completion observable after a canceled caller.
